#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tau Launcher — modular, multi-user, multi-LLM
#
# Collapse chain (first hit wins):
#   1. $TAU_BIN (explicit override)
#   2. Installed `tau` on PATH (not this script — avoids recursion)
#   3. ./tau in current directory (local project override)
#   4. Source mode: bun run <engine>/packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts
#   5. Dist binary: <engine>/packages/coding-agent/dist/omp
#
# Profiles: $HOME/.tau/profiles/<name>.yml
#   Each profile selects LLM backend, model, and engine args.
#   Use --profile <name> or TAU_PROFILE env.
#
# Locking: flock on $HOME/.tau/.launcher.lock prevents concurrent
#   state-corrupting runs. Held only during startup/migration, not
#   for the whole session.
#
# Migrations: profile schema versioned. On load, if profile version
#   < CURRENT_SCHEMA, migrate forward automatically.

set -euo pipefail

# ── HOME resolution (multi-user) ──────────────────────────────────────
# Never hardcode /home/toxic. Respect $HOME; the bridge sometimes runs
# with HOME=/home/hatch even as user toxic, so fall back to the real
# user's home via getent when $HOME looks wrong.
resolve_home() {
    local h="${HOME:-}"
    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ -d "$h/.tau" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$h"
        return
    fi
    local user_home
    user_home="$(getent passwd "${USER:-$(id -un)}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)"
    if [ -n "$user_home" ] && [ -d "$user_home" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$user_home"
        return
    fi
    printf '%s' "${h:-/home/toxic}"
}
TAU_HOME="$(resolve_home)"
export TAU_HOME

TAU_DIR="$TAU_HOME/.tau"
PROFILES_DIR="$TAU_DIR/profiles"
LOCK_FILE="$TAU_DIR/.launcher.lock"
CURRENT_SCHEMA=2

mkdir -p "$PROFILES_DIR"

# ── Secrets (per-user) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
set +u
[ -f "$TAU_HOME/.secrets" ] && { set -a; . "$TAU_HOME/.secrets" >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; }
[ -f "$TAU_HOME/.config/claude/env" ] && { set -a; . "$TAU_HOME/.config/claude/env" >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; }
set -u

export PI_CONFIG_DIR=".tau"

# ── Profile loading + migration ───────────────────────────────────────
TAU_PROFILE="${TAU_PROFILE:-default}"
# Allow --profile <name> as first arg
if [ "${1:-}" = "--profile" ] && [ -n "${2:-}" ]; then
    TAU_PROFILE="$2"
    shift 2
fi

migrate_profile() {
    local profile_file="$1"
    local version
    version="$(rg 'schema_version:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*schema_version:[[:space:]]*//' | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
    version="${version:-1}"

    if [ "$version" -lt "$CURRENT_SCHEMA" ]; then
        # v1 → v2: add llm.backend field, default to auto
        if [ "$version" -eq 1 ]; then
            if ! rg -q 'backend:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null; then
                printf '\nllm:\n  backend: auto\n' >> "$profile_file"
            fi
            # Bump version marker
            if rg -q 'schema_version:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null; then
                sed -i 's/schema_version:\s*[0-9]*/schema_version: 2/' "$profile_file"
            else
                printf 'schema_version: 2\n' >> "$profile_file"
            fi
        fi
    fi
}

load_profile() {
    local profile_file="$PROFILES_DIR/$TAU_PROFILE.yml"
    if [ ! -f "$profile_file" ]; then
        # Create default profile on first run
        cat > "$profile_file" <<'EOF'
schema_version: 2
# LLM backend: auto | anthropic | openai | kimi | ollama
llm:
  backend: auto
  model: null
engine:
  args: []
EOF
    fi

    # Migrate under lock
    (
        flock -w 10 200 || { echo "tau: could not acquire profile lock" >&2; exit 1; }
        migrate_profile "$profile_file"
    ) 200>"$LOCK_FILE"

    # Export profile settings as env (portable parsing, no PCRE)
    local backend
    backend="$(rg 'backend:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*backend:[[:space:]]*//' | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
    backend="${backend:-auto}"
    export TAU_LLM_BACKEND="$backend"

    local model
    model="$(rg '^[[:space:]]*model:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*model:[[:space:]]*//' | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
    if [ -n "$model" ] && [ "$model" != "null" ]; then
        export TAU_LLM_MODEL="$model"
    fi
}

load_profile

# ── Engine resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Sovereign checkout location (also HOME-aware)
SOVEREIGN_DIR="$TAU_HOME/sovereign"
ENGINE_DIR="$SOVEREIGN_DIR/tau/engine"
ENGINE_ENTRY="$ENGINE_DIR/packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts"
DIST_BIN="$ENGINE_DIR/packages/coding-agent/dist/omp"

# Collapse chain
launch() {
    # 1. Explicit override
    if [ -n "${TAU_BIN:-}" ] && [ -x "$TAU_BIN" ]; then
        exec "$TAU_BIN" "$@"
    fi

    # 2. Installed tau on PATH (guard against self-recursion)
    local path_tau
    path_tau="$(command -v tau 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -n "$path_tau" ] && [ "$path_tau" != "$0" ] && [ -x "$path_tau" ]; then
        # Avoid infinite loop: only use if it's not this script
        if ! rg -q "Tau Launcher — modular" "$path_tau" 2>/dev/null; then
            exec "$path_tau" "$@"
        fi
    fi

    # 3. Local ./tau override
    if [ -x "./tau" ] && [ "$(realpath ./tau 2>/dev/null)" != "$(realpath "$0" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        exec ./tau "$@"
    fi

    # 4. Source mode (bun) — patches take effect immediately
    if [ -f "$ENGINE_ENTRY" ] && command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        exec bun run "$ENGINE_ENTRY" "$@"
    fi

    # 5. Dist binary fallback
    if [ -x "$DIST_BIN" ]; then
        exec "$DIST_BIN" "$@"
    fi

    echo "tau: no launch target found" >&2
    echo "  checked: TAU_BIN, PATH, ./tau" >&2
    echo "  checked: $ENGINE_ENTRY (bun: $(command -v bun || echo missing))" >&2
    echo "  checked: $DIST_BIN" >&2
    exit 1
}

launch "$@"

#
# Collapse chain (first hit wins):
#   1. $TAU_BIN (explicit override)
#   2. Installed `tau` on PATH (not this script — avoids recursion)
#   3. ./tau in current directory (local project override)
#   4. Source mode: bun run <engine>/packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts
#   5. Dist binary: <engine>/packages/coding-agent/dist/omp
#
# Profiles: $HOME/.tau/profiles/<name>.yml
#   Each profile selects LLM backend, model, and engine args.
#   Use --profile <name> or TAU_PROFILE env.
#
# Locking: flock on $HOME/.tau/.launcher.lock prevents concurrent
#   state-corrupting runs. Held only during startup/migration, not
#   for the whole session.
#
# Migrations: profile schema versioned. On load, if profile version
#   < CURRENT_SCHEMA, migrate forward automatically.

set -euo pipefail

# ── HOME resolution (multi-user) ──────────────────────────────────────
# Never hardcode /home/toxic. Respect $HOME; the bridge sometimes runs
# with HOME=/home/hatch even as user toxic, so fall back to the real
# user's home via getent when $HOME looks wrong.
resolve_home() {
    local h="${HOME:-}"
    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ -d "$h/.tau" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$h"
        return
    fi
    local user_home
    user_home="$(getent passwd "${USER:-$(id -un)}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)"
    if [ -n "$user_home" ] && [ -d "$user_home" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$user_home"
        return
    fi
    printf '%s' "${h:-/home/toxic}"
}
TAU_HOME="$(resolve_home)"
export TAU_HOME

TAU_DIR="$TAU_HOME/.tau"
PROFILES_DIR="$TAU_DIR/profiles"
LOCK_FILE="$TAU_DIR/.launcher.lock"
CURRENT_SCHEMA=2

mkdir -p "$PROFILES_DIR"

# ── Secrets (per-user) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
set +u
[ -f "$TAU_HOME/.secrets" ] && { set -a; . "$TAU_HOME/.secrets" >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; }
[ -f "$TAU_HOME/.config/claude/env" ] && { set -a; . "$TAU_HOME/.config/claude/env" >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; }
set -u

export PI_CONFIG_DIR=".tau"

# ── Profile loading + migration ───────────────────────────────────────
TAU_PROFILE="${TAU_PROFILE:-default}"
# Allow --profile <name> as first arg
if [ "${1:-}" = "--profile" ] && [ -n "${2:-}" ]; then
    TAU_PROFILE="$2"
    shift 2
fi

migrate_profile() {
    local profile_file="$1"
    local version
    version="$(rg 'schema_version:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*schema_version:[[:space:]]*//' | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
    version="${version:-1}"

    if [ "$version" -lt "$CURRENT_SCHEMA" ]; then
        # v1 → v2: add llm.backend field, default to auto
        if [ "$version" -eq 1 ]; then
            if ! rg -q 'backend:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null; then
                printf '\nllm:\n  backend: auto\n' >> "$profile_file"
            fi
            # Bump version marker
            if rg -q 'schema_version:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null; then
                sed -i 's/schema_version:\s*[0-9]*/schema_version: 2/' "$profile_file"
            else
                printf 'schema_version: 2\n' >> "$profile_file"
            fi
        fi
    fi
}

load_profile() {
    local profile_file="$PROFILES_DIR/$TAU_PROFILE.yml"
    if [ ! -f "$profile_file" ]; then
        # Create default profile on first run
        cat > "$profile_file" <<'EOF'
schema_version: 2
# LLM backend: auto | anthropic | openai | kimi | ollama
llm:
  backend: auto
  model: null
engine:
  args: []
EOF
    fi

    local backend

1|#!/usr/bin/env bash
2|# Tau Launcher — modular, multi-user, multi-LLM
3|#
4|# Collapse chain (first hit wins):
5|#   1. $TAU_BIN (explicit override)
6|#   2. Installed `tau` on PATH (not this script — avoids recursion)
7|#   3. ./tau in current directory (local project override)
8|#   4. Source mode: bun run <engine>/packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts
9|#   5. Dist binary: <engine>/packages/coding-agent/dist/omp
10|#
11|# Profiles: $HOME/.tau/profiles/<name>.yml
12|#   Each profile selects LLM backend, model, and engine args.
13|#   Use --profile <name> or TAU_PROFILE env.
14|#
15|# Locking: flock on $HOME/.tau/.launcher.lock prevents concurrent
16|#   state-corrupting runs. Held only during startup/migration, not
17|#   for the whole session.
18|#
19|# Migrations: profile schema versioned. On load, if profile version
20|#   < CURRENT_SCHEMA, migrate forward automatically.
21|
22|set -euo pipefail
23|
24|# ── HOME resolution (multi-user) ──────────────────────────────────────
25|# Never hardcode /home/toxic. Respect $HOME; the bridge sometimes runs
26|# with HOME=/home/hatch even as user toxic, so fall back to the real
27|# user's home via getent when $HOME looks wrong.
28|resolve_home() {
29|    local h="${HOME:-}"
30|    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ -d "$h/.tau" ]; then
31|        printf '%s' "$h"
32|        return
33|    fi
34|    local user_home
35|    user_home="$(getent passwd "${USER:-$(id -un)}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)"
36|    if [ -n "$user_home" ] && [ -d "$user_home" ]; then
37|        printf '%s' "$user_home"
38|        return
39|    fi
40|    printf '%s' "${h:-/home/toxic}"
41|}
42|TAU_HOME="$(resolve_home)"
43|export TAU_HOME
44|
45|TAU_DIR="$TAU_HOME/.tau"
46|PROFILES_DIR="$TAU_DIR/profiles"
47|LOCK_FILE="$TAU_DIR/.launcher.lock"
48|CURRENT_SCHEMA=2
49|
50|mkdir -p "$PROFILES_DIR"
51|
52|# ── Secrets (per-user) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
53|set +u
54|[ -f "$TAU_HOME/.secrets" ] && { set -a; . "$TAU_HOME/.secrets" >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; }
55|[ -f "$TAU_HOME/.config/claude/env" ] && { set -a; . "$TAU_HOME/.config/claude/env" >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; }
56|set -u
57|
58|export PI_CONFIG_DIR=".tau"
59|
60|# ── Profile loading + migration ───────────────────────────────────────
61|TAU_PROFILE="${TAU_PROFILE:-default}"
62|# Allow --profile <name> as first arg
63|if [ "${1:-}" = "--profile" ] && [ -n "${2:-}" ]; then
64|    TAU_PROFILE="$2"
65|    shift 2
66|fi
67|
68|migrate_profile() {
69|    local profile_file="$1"
70|    local version
71|    version="$(rg 'schema_version:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*schema_version:[[:space:]]*//' | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
72|    version="${version:-1}"
73|
74|    if [ "$version" -lt "$CURRENT_SCHEMA" ]; then
75|        # v1 → v2: add llm.backend field, default to auto
76|        if [ "$version" -eq 1 ]; then
77|            if ! rg -q 'backend:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null; then
78|                printf '\nllm:\n  backend: auto\n' >> "$profile_file"
79|            fi
80|            # Bump version marker
81|            if rg -q 'schema_version:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null; then
82|                sed -i 's/schema_version:\s*[0-9]*/schema_version: 2/' "$profile_file"
83|            else
84|                printf 'schema_version: 2\n' >> "$profile_file"
85|            fi
86|        fi
87|    fi
88|}
89|
90|load_profile() {
91|    local profile_file="$PROFILES_DIR/$TAU_PROFILE.yml"
92|    if [ ! -f "$profile_file" ]; then
93|        # Create default profile on first run
94|        cat > "$profile_file" <<'EOF'
95|schema_version: 2
96|# LLM backend: auto | anthropic | openai | kimi | ollama
97|llm:
98|  backend: auto
99|  model: null
100|engine:
101|  args: []
102|EOF
103|    fi
104|
105|    # Migrate under lock
106|    (
107|        flock -w 10 200 || { echo "tau: could not acquire profile lock" >&2; exit 1; }
108|        migrate_profile "$profile_file"
109|    ) 200>"$LOCK_FILE"
110|
111|    # Export profile settings as env (portable parsing, no PCRE)

115|    export TAU_LLM_BACKEND="$backend"
116|

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tau Launcher — modular, multi-user, multi-LLM
#
# Collapse chain (first hit wins):
#   1. $TAU_BIN (explicit override)
#   2. Installed `tau` on PATH (not this script — avoids recursion)
#   3. ./tau in current directory (local project override)
#   4. Source mode: bun run <engine>/packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts
#   5. Dist binary: <engine>/packages/coding-agent/dist/omp
#
# Profiles: $HOME/.tau/profiles/<name>.yml
#   Each profile selects LLM backend, model, and engine args.
#   Use --profile <name> or TAU_PROFILE env.
#
# Locking: flock on $HOME/.tau/.launcher.lock prevents concurrent
#   state-corrupting runs. Held only during startup/migration, not
#   for the whole session.
#
# Migrations: profile schema versioned. On load, if profile version
#   < CURRENT_SCHEMA, migrate forward automatically.

set -euo pipefail

# ── HOME resolution (multi-user) ──────────────────────────────────────
# Never hardcode /home/toxic. Respect $HOME; the bridge sometimes runs
# with HOME=/home/hatch even as user toxic, so fall back to the real
# user's home via getent when $HOME looks wrong.
resolve_home() {
    local h="${HOME:-}"
    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ -d "$h/.tau" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$h"
        return
    fi
    local user_home
    user_home="$(getent passwd "${USER:-$(id -un)}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)"
    if [ -n "$user_home" ] && [ -d "$user_home" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$user_home"
        return
    fi
    printf '%s' "${h:-/home/toxic}"
}
TAU_HOME="$(resolve_home)"
export TAU_HOME

TAU_DIR="$TAU_HOME/.tau"
PROFILES_DIR="$TAU_DIR/profiles"
LOCK_FILE="$TAU_DIR/.launcher.lock"
CURRENT_SCHEMA=2

mkdir -p "$PROFILES_DIR"

# ── Secrets (per-user) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
set +u
[ -f "$TAU_HOME/.secrets" ] && { set -a; . "$TAU_HOME/.secrets" >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; }
[ -f "$TAU_HOME/.config/claude/env" ] && { set -a; . "$TAU_HOME/.config/claude/env" >/dev/null 2>&1; set +a; }
set -u

TAU_PROFILE="${TAU_PROFILE:-default}"
# Allow --profile <name> as first arg
if [ "${1:-}" = "--profile" ] && [ -n "${2:-}" ]; then
    TAU_PROFILE="$2"
    shift 2
fi

migrate_profile() {
    local profile_file="$1"
    local version
    version="$(rg 'schema_version:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*schema_version:[[:space:]]*//' | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
    version="${version:-1}"

    if [ "$version" -lt "$CURRENT_SCHEMA" ]; then
        # v1 → v2: add llm.backend field, default to auto
        if [ "$version" -eq 1 ]; then
            if ! rg -q 'backend:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null; then
                printf '\nllm:\n  backend: auto\n' >> "$profile_file"
            fi
            # Bump version marker
            if rg -q 'schema_version:' "$profile_file" 2>/dev/null; then
                sed -i 's/schema_version:\s*[0-9]*/schema_version: 2/' "$profile_file"
            else
                printf 'schema_version: 2\n' >> "$profile_file"
            fi
        fi
    fi

    local profile_file="$PROFILES_DIR/$TAU_PROFILE.yml"

schema_version: 2
# LLM backend: auto | anthropic | openai | kimi | ollama
llm:
  backend: auto
  model: null
engine:
  args: []
EOF
    fi

    fi

fi

    echo "  checked: $ENGINE_ENTRY (bun: $(command -v bun || echo missing))" >&2
    echo "  checked: $DIST_BIN" >&2

            echo "  build    - Build the coding-agent binary"

    # 2. Installed tau on PATH (guard against self-recursion)
    local path_tau
    path_tau="$(command -v tau 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -n "$path_tau" ] && [ "$path_tau" != "$0" ] && [ -x "$path_tau" ]; then
        # Avoid infinite loop: only use if it's not this script
        if ! rg -q "Tau Launcher — modular" "$path_tau" 2>/dev/null; then

        fi
    fi

    # 3. Local ./tau override
    if [ -x "./tau" ] && [ "$(realpath ./tau 2>/dev/null)" != "$(realpath "$0" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        exec ./tau "$@"
    fi

    # 4. Source mode (bun) — patches take effect immediately
    if [ -f "$ENGINE_ENTRY" ] && command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        exec bun run "$ENGINE_ENTRY" "$@"
    fi

    # 5. Dist binary fallback
    if [ -x "$DIST_BIN" ]; then
        exec "$DIST_BIN" "$@"
    fi

    echo "  checked: TAU_BIN, PATH, ./tau" >&2
    echo "  checked: $ENGINE_ENTRY (bun: $(command -v bun || echo missing))" >&2
    echo "  checked: $DIST_BIN" >&2
    exit 1
}
